skill_name: Write a paragraph describing the history of the French Revolution.
workflow: The French Revolution began in 1789 and is considered to be one of the most influential events of European history. It stemmed from a growing discontent with the social and political inequalities that faced a majority of the French people. As a result of the Revolution, the absolute monarchy that had characterized the French government was overthrown and the first French Republic was declared.
